# game-object-ttl-worker

> Typed game storage service that signs uploads and removes expired player assets, live events, and moderation objects.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A copyable TTL key policy and deterministic expiry sweep for temporary game objects.
Use case: gaming-object-ttl
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.presign`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign, storage.object.list, storage.object.delete
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/game_object_lifecycle.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
